news.html: New flagship project: Optimal-Transport Flow Matching for Traffic Forecasting — a generative OT flow for a University of Padova deep-learning challenge.
Started an M.Sc. in Computer Science at the University of Padova, steering toward pure mathematics & generative models.
Manuscript in preparation: Boosting the SDE Framework of Generative Models towards Time-Series Data.
Paper Enhancing Meta-Learning Retail Forecasting with Diffusion submitted to the European Journal of Operational Research (EJOR).
Defended my B.Sc. thesis at the University of Isfahan — a verification system built around a generative image-enhancement pipeline.
